# DeepFist native reference helpers

MIT, copyright Brent Crier (N9BC). Imported from the public Lyra-SDR-cpp source at commit `91167c80d1fbbaf6a6610006acad37f3a50f4368`, `src/dsp/deepfist/`. Only local include paths are adjusted. Original source: https://github.com/N8SDR1/Lyra-SDR-cpp/tree/91167c80d1fbbaf6a6610006acad37f3a50f4368/src/dsp/deepfist

The experimental AetherSDR wrapper pins the model and sidecar hashes before using these helpers. The model is not committed here. These helpers represent the Lyra native profile, not numerical parity with the current DeepFist Python front-end.
